description: The 19-channel GOES Sounder on GOES-10 (18 infrared channels from 3.7 to 14.7 um and one visible channel, four detectors each). The curves are the operational per-detector spectral response functions distributed by NOAA OSPO.
facility_description: GOES-8 to GOES-15 were NOAA's third-generation geostationary weather satellites (GOES I-M and N-P series).

links.label: OSPO GOES Sounder Spectral Response Functions

notes: Operational SRF set per the OSPO table; file-to-channel/detector mapping from each archive's README. The GOES-8/10 'Updated on 9/28/98' ITT sets are not used (OSPO: 'NESDIS did NOT use these updated SRFs in its operational product generation'). Band names follow SVO's GOES/Sounder IDs (IR<ch>_d<det>, VIS_d<det>); pivots agree with SVO's archived records to <0.01 %. DetectorType energy is assumed.

licence.scope: No owner statement verified. The NOAA NESDIS OSPO page that distributes the SRFs carries no terms; its footer only links NOAA's disclaimer (https://www.noaa.gov/disclaimer), which refused the request (CloudFront 403) and was not verified. The page says 'The SRFs were provided by ITT, the instruments' manufacturer'. Bands taken from SVO rather than OSPO: The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
